changelog:
arxiv-cv-daily 1.0.0

- Initial release for automated, topic-centric daily arXiv cs.CV paper workflows.
- Supports paper fetching, topic screening, PDF download, and full-text summarization, all controlled by a user-supplied topic and date.
- Organized all workflow outputs—including logs, screening results, PDFs, and summaries—under a user-chosen output directory.
- Sequential, day-by-day processing with clear user progress updates and mobile-friendly result formatting.
- Allows detailed, citation-backed analysis for selected papers upon user request.
- Workflow fully independent—no reliance on other research or ideation skills.
